# GrowthAudit

GrowthAudit provides conversion audits, workflow repair, and AI agent setup for founders and small teams. The offer is scoped, evidence-based, and delivered as a prioritized backlog or working configuration. Payment is accepted through Alipay or WeChat Pay. No service guarantees revenue.

## Services

### AI Agent Setup Help

A 45-minute fixed-price working session to configure one practical AI agent workflow. The client selects one task, the configuration is completed during the session, and the deliverables include a working workflow, documentation, verification steps, and a reusable checklist.

- Price: $29.
- Page: https://newworldba.github.io/ai-growth-audit/agent-setup.html
- Apply: https://newworldba.github.io/ai-growth-audit/apply.html?package=AI%20Agent%20Setup%20Help%20%2429

### Claude Code Setup Help

A 45-minute fixed-price working session to make one Claude Code workflow safe and repeatable. Suitable workflows include code review, test repair, release notes, issue triage, deployment checks, and guarded terminal work.

- Price: $29.
- Page: https://newworldba.github.io/ai-growth-audit/claude-code-setup.html
- Apply: https://newworldba.github.io/ai-growth-audit/apply.html?package=Claude%20Code%20Setup%20Help%20%2429
- Deliverables: working workflow, permissions, verification commands, stop rules, rollback notes, and a reusable runbook.
- Access rule: access is limited to the approved scope; screen sharing is accepted; destructive commands are not run.

#### Claude Code 配置帮助 / Claude Code Setup Help in Chinese

A 45-minute fixed-price working session for a safe and repeatable Claude Code workflow. Chinese buyers can pay with Alipay or WeChat Pay.

- Price: ¥199 / $29.
- Page: https://newworldba.github.io/ai-growth-audit/zh/claude-code-setup.html
- Apply: https://newworldba.github.io/ai-growth-audit/zh/apply.html?package=Claude%20Code%20%E9%85%8D%E7%BD%AE%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1%20%C2%A5199

### Conversion Audits

Focused audits turn live-site friction into prioritized implementation actions. They are available for one page, a small multi-page funnel, or an implementation sprint.

- Quick Audit: $149, one key page, top 10 prioritized fixes, 48-hour delivery.
- Growth Audit: $399, up to five pages, conversion plus SEO and mobile review, competitor snapshot, 30-day plan.
- Implementation Sprint: $999, implementation of up to ten approved changes.
- Apply: https://newworldba.github.io/ai-growth-audit/apply.html
